subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord support opt-in silent transcription of unmentioned audio into pending history, and what authorization, retention, privacy, and cost boundaries must apply?
rationale: The code change is mechanically plausible, but the permanent product contract would process user audio that did not mention the bot and add a new config surface in a stable channel.

options.title: Approve bounded opt-in mode
options.body: Add a default-off Discord guild/channel option with allowlist-aware transcription, bounded retention, untrusted transcript markings, docs, and focused tests for skipped-history replay.

options.title: Keep current mention-only behavior
options.body: Leave audio preflight scoped to mention detection and document that users must mention the bot or disable mention gating for voice-memo workflows.

options.title: Design shared channel contract first
options.body: Pause the Discord-specific option and define a reusable media-history/preflight contract that can also cover related Signal and WhatsApp gaps.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded opt-in mode
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Discord guild/channel option with allowlist-aware transcription, bounded retention, untrusted transcript markings, docs, and focused tests for skipped-history replay.
